_comment: Detail checklist of the class (asset.check section coverage): the definition of done of an asset
of this class. Generated from the vanilla models of the class (10; every model of the class): an item every one of them
has (95 % for classes of 20 and more) is required ('missing' blocks asset.check --strict), an item at
least a quarter of them have is optional. 'vanilla' = how many vanilla models of the class have it.
satk.style.coverage. More detail in the same SA style is welcome; nothing here is a triangle count.

items.what: a headlamp on the headlight key colours
items.fix: give the headlamp lens the key colour 255,175,0 / 0,255,200

items.what: a tail lamp on the taillight key colours
items.fix: give the tail lamp lens the key colour 185,255,0 / 255,60,0
build wheel_front and wheel_rear (tyre, rim, hub, brake disc)
shape a seat whose top sits where the rider pose expects it
build the handlebars with grips, levers and the headlamp nacelle
build forks_front: fork legs, fender, hub
build forks_rear: the swing arm with the chain guard

items.what: an exhaust at the exhaust dummy
items.fix: build the exhaust pipe and silencer ending at the exhaust dummy

items.what: an engine at the engine dummy
items.fix: build the engine block, cylinders and cases at the engine dummy
add a plate card on carpback behind the seat
add a gauge card on vehicledash32 above the bars
